While you wait, see how caching and AI Credits work with sample sessions.

welcome.learn:
Sample sessions that show how prompt caching, compaction, model switches and other events change what a turn costs. Pick one to see it turn by turn.
[Open Learn mode](command:aiCreditsAnalyzer.openLearnMode)
welcome.setup:
No setup problems found. Agent Host chats (the VS Code default) need no setting. Local harness chats record token data only while Copilot Chat debug logging is on and enough sessions are kept.
[Review the debug logging setting](command:aiCreditsAnalyzer.fixSetting)

walkthrough.step.enableLogging.altText: A settings switch for Copilot Chat debug logging turned on.
walkthrough.step.enableLogging.title: Enable Copilot Chat debug logging
walkthrough.step.enableLogging.descripti:
Local harness chats record token and AI Credits data only while debug logging is on. Agent Host chats (the VS Code default) need no setting. Turn it on for Local harness chats, then start a chat.
[Open the setting](command:aiCreditsAnalyzer.fixSetting?%5B%22github.copilot.chat.agentDebugLog.fileLogging.enabled%22%5D)
walkthrough.step.keepSessions.altText: The retained session logs setting set to 200.
walkthrough.step.keepSessions.title: Keep at least 200 sessions
walkthrough.step.keepSessions.descriptio:
Copilot Chat keeps the last 50 session logs by default. 200 gives enough history to spot trends and anomalies.
[Open the setting](command:aiCreditsAnalyzer.fixSetting?%5B%22github.copilot.chat.agentDebugLog.fileLogging.maxRetainedSessionLogs%22%5D)
walkthrough.step.openSession.altText: The Sessions view, listing today's sessions with their AI Credits totals and one marked unknown.
walkthrough.step.openSession.title: Open your first session
walkthrough.step.openSession.description:
Open the analyzer, then pick a session in the Sessions view. Each session shows its AI Credits total; "unknown" means the log had no cost data.
[Open the analyzer](command:aiCreditsAnalyzer.open)
walkthrough.step.learnCaching.altText: Two bars: a request without caching costs more than the same request with cached tokens.
walkthrough.step.learnCaching.title: Learn how prompt caching saves AI Credits
walkthrough.step.learnCaching.descriptio:
See, with sample sessions, why cached tokens cost less. Learn mode doesn't read your logs.
[Open Learn mode](command:aiCreditsAnalyzer.openLearnMode)
walkthrough.step.askCopilot.title: Ask Copilot about your costs (MCP, optional)
walkthrough.step.askCopilot.description:
Ask Copilot Chat about your costs through a read-only MCP server that answers from the same local logs. It stays off until you turn it on. When on, redacted session data (costs, tool calls, findings, turn text) is sent to the model you chat with.
[Open the setting](command:aiCreditsAnalyzer.fixSetting?%5B%22aiCreditsAnalyzer.mcp.enabled%22%5D)

capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In Restricted Mode, an untrusted workspace's settings can't turn on the MCP server.
configuration.mcp.enabled.markdownDescri:
Offer Copilot Chat a read-only MCP server that answers questions about your Copilot Chat sessions from your local logs.

**When on, read-only and redacted Copilot Chat session data (costs, tool calls, findings, turn text) is sent to whichever model the chat uses.** Secrets found in that text are redacted first, and the server never writes, runs commands or reaches the network. Off by default; in a workspace you haven't trusted, that workspace's settings can't turn it on.
configuration.monthlyAllowance.aiCredits: Your plan's monthly allowance, in **AI Credits** (not premium requests or dollars). Leave empty or 0 to turn the monthly gauge off. Read from your user settings only; a workspace cannot set it. The extension never fetches your plan, so type the number from your GitHub billing page.
Day of the month (1 to 28) your billing period starts, judged in your local time zone. Set it to match your GitHub billing page. The monthly gauge counts AI Credits from this day.
configuration.monthlyAllowance.warnAtPer: Percentage (1 to 100) of the monthly allowance, in **AI Credits**, at which the gauge warns that you are near the limit. It reads "over" at 100 percent.
